description: Hadrysic wears a textured burgundy-brown knee-length tunic with narrow gold woven borders around the split neckline, cuffs and hem. An ivory linen underlayer appears at the neck and wrists. A plain broad brown leather belt has a bronze rectangular buckle and a decorated hanging end. Brown fitted trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit. Both hands and the full boots are visible. The cloth is opaque and practical, with restrained noble textile detail. No headgear, armor, weapons or contemporary items appear.
